name: @theoremjs/studio
description: The studio's source: the profile draft, its tree and compiler, source export, and the studio screen. `npm run build:npm:studio` builds @theoremjs/studio from it into npm/, at the root package's version; this folder is never published itself. Opt-in: nothing here is installed with the kernel or the React package; `npm install` in this folder is what lets the screen run on its own.

scripts.test: node installed.mjs && npm run theme:check && deno test --config ../deno.json --no-check --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys tests
